description: This file defines a REST API backend for a personal journal app using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for health checks, CRUD operations on journal entries, date filtering, image uploads, and service initialization. The app integrates database models, file handling, CORS middleware, and static file serving, specialized for journal entry management.
